status: Upstream nonce fix deployed. Remaining Spamoor decoder/scheduling fixes passed CI and canaries; GitOps image pin prepared. Nimbus onboarding blocked by client txpool defect.

issues.summary: Keyed frame RPC nonce decoded as zero
issues.evidence: Same confirmed nonce-70 transaction from ethrex/nethermind/reth decoded as nonce 0. Clients expose nonce rather than nonceSeq. Confirmation processing sets confirmedTxCount to decoded nonce + 1.
issues.impact: Confirmation waiters fail to resolve; scenario exhausts max_pending=5000. A restart temporarily clears waiters.
issues.status: Fixed upstream in PR #302; live pod now runs 9579397 after restart pulled current master-latest. Draft PR #306 rebased to retain upstream implementation.

issues.evidence: Nethermind and reth frames decode with zero execution gas; reconstructed transaction hash differs from RPC hash. Geth uses the same field names.
issues.status: Fixed in PR #306; gas alias tests and four-client reconstructed hashes pass. Not deployed.

issues.summary: Empty Geth signature signer breaks typed frame decoding
issues.evidence: Geth signer "0x" fails common.Address unmarshalling and silently falls back to UnknownTx.
issues.status: Fixed in PR #306 with byte-string signer decoding; Geth fixture reconstructs exact hash. Nimbus also returns empty signer bytes. Not deployed.

issues.summary: frametx pipelines multiple pending transactions per sender
issues.evidence: throughput=1000, max_wallets=500, max_pending=0 resolves to 5000 concurrent attempts. Logs show sender already has a pending frame transaction and nonce-too-high rejection.
issues.status: Per-wallet serialization in PR #306 passed local integration and a live canary. Follows EIP-8141 acceptance rule 7; no client-error matching or validation bypass. Deployment pending.

issues.summary: Pending log is a nonce-distance estimate, not a mempool count
issues.evidence: Log reported pending=430278; sample client mempools held roughly 116-140 pending transactions. Incorrect decoded confirmations inflate the estimate further.
issues.status: decoder fix addresses corruption; metric remains a nonce-distance estimate

issues.summary: Both Besu nodes stalled at block 1787
issues.evidence: Spamoor API reports both Besu endpoints ready=false at block 1787 while nine other endpoints advance above 28500. Direct eth_blockNumber confirms 1787 on both; eth_syncing incorrectly suggests no active sync (false).
issues.status: open; separate existing client synchronization failure, no node changes made

issues.summary: Restart reuses wallets whose transactions remain in mempools
issues.evidence: Five replacement-underpriced warnings immediately after 14:27:56 UTC scenario initialization; later nonce-too-high and pending-sender errors.
issues.status: Restart clears local waiters but can collide with transactions already in client pools. Upstream decoder fix deployed; sender serialization remains under test. Do not increase fees based solely on these errors.

issues.summary: Unused do-sfo3-services-sfo3 kube context has expired credentials
issues.evidence: Read-only discovery returned authentication required. The services context works.
issues.status: unrelated tooling issue; used services context

issues.evidence: 30 transaction-underpriced warnings in the sampled restart window, in addition to five replacement-underpriced warnings.
issues.status: observed; not proven to be a separate client defect, recheck after recovery

issues.evidence: Original pod ran aed872d while upstream #302 was already merged. Restart pulled 9579397. Mutable tags do not update an already running pod.
issues.status: Current upstream deployed; version verified through public API.

issues.summary: GitOps reverted direct Spamoor image override
issues.evidence: A direct StatefulSet image change to bogota-frame-recovery-a32edd3 was reconciled back to master-latest. The custom build was not durably deployed.
issues.status: No further direct overrides; old custom build superseded by rebased draft e9b66be.

issues.summary: Authentication JWKS fetch briefly returned HTTP 520 during startup
issues.evidence: Pod startup at 14:43:55 UTC was delayed by an external auth JWKS request; service subsequently started and scenario resumed at 14:45:36 UTC.

issues.summary: Nimbus rejects non-blob frame transactions as invalid blobs and disconnects peers
issues.evidence: Nimbus bogota-devnet-1 8747b0e8 rejects a Geth-accepted type-0x6 transaction with RPC error data txErrorInvalidBlob. tx_desc.nim:443 applies blob-wrapper validation to every TxEip8141; validateBlobTransactionWrapper returns tx wrapper is none for non-blob frames. eth_broadcast.nim:379 disconnects on this error. Both local peers dropped to net_peerCount=0 after frame traffic.
issues.status: Client-side onboarding blocker; no Spamoor workaround and no live Nimbus node provisioned. See Nimbus readiness artifact.

issues.summary: Capability predeploy detection can start frame traffic before activation
issues.evidence: Local test installs predeploys at genesis but activates Heze at epoch 1. frametx starts before activation and Geth reports not Bogota. After activation Geth accepts frames.
issues.status: Observed in local test; separate from live devnet stall. No error-string workaround introduced.

issues.summary: Cached mutable Geth image invalidated first local compatibility run
issues.evidence: Initial local tag resolved to older cached 313ff90, not live 8dfba15f. Discarded that run and recreated only the task enclave using image digests.
issues.status: Corrected test provenance; Nimbus images.yaml retains user-requested bogota-devnet-1 tag.

tests: Full GitHub CI: go test -race -vet=off ./..., go vet ./..., staticcheck, generated symbols/docs, CLI and import builds

live_canary.note: Separate canary with fresh wallets against all existing RPCs; existing main scenario continued unchanged. Three-minute sample is not a long soak.

changes.action: Spamoor pod restarted; current upstream master-latest pulled

monitoring.upstream_recovery: Blocks 28576 onward confirm again. Pending subsequently reached about 5000. Block 28599 confirmed 1095, block 28602 confirmed 105; recovery is not yet considered durable.

configuration_note: With one pending frame transaction per sender, 500 wallets bound steady-state submissions to roughly 500 per block despite throughput=1000. The requested rate remains unchanged; increasing wallet count is a separate workload decision.
